info.description:
## Start here

1. Get an API key from the person who manages Calyx, or create one on the Calyx web page. A key starts with `cx_`.
2. Send each request to `/api/v1` on the address of Calyx, with the header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
3. Call `GET /api/v1/me` to check the key.
4. Send a message with `POST /api/v1/instances/{id}/messages` and an `Idempotency-Key` header. A second request with the
   same key never sends the message again.
5. An error answer has the type `application/problem+json`. Read its `code`. When the answer has a `Retry-After` header,
   wait that number of seconds before the next request.

post.description: Errors: 400 invalid_request (also the core's pacing refusal), 401 unauthenticated, 403 csrf_check_failed, 404 not_found, 409 instance_not_connected, 409 instance_not_ready, 409 idempotency_key_conflict, 413 too_many_messages, 502 core_rejected_token, 504 bulk_outcome_unknown. Send either recipients with text, or messages. Anti-spam: with text, each recipient appears once; with messages, a recipient gets at most 2 messages. Pacing units: delay and pause_duration are in milliseconds, pause_every counts messages. The backend adds no pacing and never lowers it. A 504 bulk_outcome_unknown means that the job may run in the core without a backend record. With an Idempotency-Key, retry with the same key: the retry gives the job and stores it. Without a key, the job cannot be read or cancelled through the backend, and the core's bulk.finished webhook still reports it. Do not start it again automatically.

A 504 send_outcome_unknown means the message may or may not have been sent. Send an Idempotency-Key header. After a 504, retry with the same key: the core sends the message at most once. After 429 instance_queue_full or 409 send_in_progress, wait for the time in Retry-After, then retry with the same key. Without a key, do not retry automatically. A resend with a known Idempotency-Key gets its answer also while the instance is not connected.

Use the same key only to retry the same request after an answer that did not arrive. When an answer has a `Retry-After` header, wait for that time, then retry with the same key. After a 504, retry with the same key. The key is kept for 24 hours. All callers of one instance share its keys.

200.description: Events: update (data: a PairingUpdate), done (data: {"status":"CONNECTED"}), failed (data: {"code":"pairing_expired|pairing_failed|pairing_cancelled","detail":"..."}). A comment line ": ping" comes every 15 seconds. The stream ends after done or failed. A stream that ends without one of them means the server stopped: reconnect, or read the instance with GET /instances/{id}.
